Menu.Name: Sheet headers
Menu.Label: Configure headers
Menu.Hint: Choose a header image for each class and for player and non-player characters.

Multiclass.Name: Multiclass header
Multiclass.Hint: Which class picks the header of a character with several classes.

PlayerOnly.Name: Class images for player characters only
PlayerOnly.Hint: When enabled, class images are only used on characters owned by a player.

AllowPlayers.Name: Players can choose their header
AllowPlayers.Hint: Lets a character's owners give it its own header image from the sheet.

Config.Title: Sheet headers
Config.Hint: Priority: the character's own image, then its class image, then the general image, then the campaign image. Drag the preview to move the image and use the wheel or the slider to zoom.
Config.Force: Force for everyone (ignores class and character images)
Config.DisabledNotice: Custom headers are off: every sheet uses the basic D&D5e header. Your images are still saved.
Config.NoClasses: No classes found in the world or the compendiums.

ActorConfig.Title: Sheet header
ActorConfig.Hint: An image for this character only. Leave it empty to use its class image.
ActorConfig.Inherited: Without its own image it uses
ActorConfig.Disabled: The GM has turned custom headers off, so the basic header is shown.
ActorConfig.Forced: The campaign image is forced for everyone, so this character's own image won't show while it is.

Editor.Hint: Drag to move · Wheel to zoom
